excerpt: The CEJ provides trainings and workshops for journalists and media personnel from across Pakistan. They’re held on a range of topics relevant to the field such as Data, Digital, Mobile and Investigative Journalism among others. All of our trainings are sponsored by various organizations. These trainings provide journalists with opportunities to learn new skills or hone their skills. Modules are designed keeping in mind the goals of the workshop and the target audience. Applications are opened for both working journalists as well as media students to give them an opportunity to learn from media professionals. The workshops cater to basic, intermediate and advanced levels. Applicant requirements are listed in the call for applications. CEJ’s trainers are drawn from a pool of senior national and international journalists experienced in conducting trainings and workshops. The CEJ organizes media presentation workshops that aims to give intense and personalized training sessions to senior executives, company spokespersons and government officials in small groups, on how to convey the key message of their organizations, confidently and professionally, in various types of interviews. The CEJ, in collaboration with its partners, has organized the National Media Fellowship and Humanitarian Reporting Fellowships, focusing on critical issues such as gender-based violence, child marriage, and humanitarian reporting. Building on this experience, we continue to work closely with our partners to develop and deliver future fellowship opportunities.
